texts.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waits at the gate to swear a truce, and {A_nameDef} has asked the council to send {X_objective} away. {A_nameDef} swore vengeance on {FACTION} for {VICTIM}, and says a truce with them would make that oath worth nothing.
Their envoy {X_nameDef} is at the gate under the sign of parley. {A_nameDef} has not forgotten {VICTIM}, and stood up before the council to say the colony owes {FACTION} nothing but a fight.

[pet] {A_nameDef} swore to make {FACTION} pay for {VICTIM}, and now their envoy {X_nameDef} waits at the gate with a truce. {A_nameDef} wants the council to hear what that means to {A_objective} before anyone walks out there.

li.label: Swear the truce all the same
li.outcome: The council heard {A_nameDef} out and sent the speaker out to {X_nameDef} all the same. {A_nameDef} watched from the wall and said nothing.

li.label: Send their envoy away
li.outcome: The council sided with {A_nameDef}. {X_nameDef} was told at the gate there would be no truce, and turned for home.
